entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kushan Empire, a political institution in Afghanistan during Kushan Empire and Gandharan Buddhism (30–250). Grew from Indo-Greek and Indo-Scythian Period. Led to the emergence of Kanishka I convenes the Fourth Buddhist Council and patronizes Mahayana Buddhism and Late Kushan and Kidarites.
